name: future-conflicts
pitch: Advance-Wars-style turn-based tactics: grid battles between the Blue Army (player) and Red Army (AI), with commanders, economy, and fog of war.

core.entry: Battle.apply(action: Action): Boolean  // single mutation funnel; Action is a sealed type (Wait/Attack/Capture/Build/Upgrade/SupplyDrop/EndTurn)
core.determinism: Event-driven, turn-based (no continuous loop). EndTurn resolves the enemy turn synchronously and instantly. Seeded-RNG supply drops ARE implemented: Battle(seed: Long = DEFAULT_SEED = 0x5EED_1234L) holds `rng = Random(seed)`; beginTurn() emits Action.SupplyDrop(team, Supply.roll(rng)) every Supply.INTERVAL (7) turns per side; execSupplyDrop applies GOLD/REINFORCE/HEAL/REVEAL boons; restart() reseeds. Runs are reproducible/replay-friendly given (seed, input sequence).
invariants: no two units occupy the same tile
effective stats fold base + commander passives + elite bonuses via the stat pipeline (effectiveMove/effectiveMaxRange/attackMul/defenseMul)

render.entry: GameScreen.kt — a single Compose Canvas (drawRect/drawRoundRect tiles + glyphs; the ONLY gameplay file that touches Compose)
render.reactivity: MANUAL: GameScreen holds `var version by mutableStateOf(0)`; an `act { }` wrapper bumps `version++` after every core mutation. New renderer-visible state requires a version++ or it won't repaint.
render.spriteRegistry: none yet — rendering is primitives + letter glyphs; sprite pass planned in docs/ART.md

commands.gotcha: The jvm() target exists ONLY for host testing — the app ships from androidLibrary + iOS. Never pipe gradlew through tail/head when you need the result; redirect to a file and check $? or grep 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL'/'BUILD FAILED'.

testing.support: TestSupport.kt — flatMap(), occupancy(), battleOf(), battleWith() build tiny deterministic scenarios.
testing.policy: Add/update tests with every change; commit only when green. (README/ROADMAP claim 38 tests but there are 45 — a doc-sync target.)

files: game/Combat.kt — hand-written 6x6 base-damage matchup table + terrain/HP scaling
game/Commander.kt — passive magnitudes, Elite bonuses (2x cost, +1 move, +20% FP, +10% armor), rebuy multipliers 1.4-1.6
tuning.note: Constants are inline across these files (admitted first-guess in BACKLOG [balance]). A sweep should extract them into a single Balance object in game/ as step 0. NOTE: enemy AI has no economy, so auto-play balancing is currently limited to the tactical layer.

maps.legend: . plains, - road, f forest, m mountain, c city, s sea, H HQ
maps.validate: Movement.reachable (no sealed armies), both HQs present, symmetry, balanced city counts. There is no loader/editor yet.

factions.format: data: id, name, theme, signature UnitType, rebuyMultiplier, List<Passive(kind ∈ MOVE/RANGE/FIREPOWER/ARMOR/INCOME/DISCOUNT, amount)>
factions.validate: auto-write a CommanderTest asserting each passive kind's effect via the stat pipeline

docs.conventions: Keep game/ Compose/Android-free (enforced by package convention only — the :core extraction isn't done). Cut a corner -> add a BACKLOG line; fix it -> delete the line. VISION.md has an 'Open questions' section for /brainstorm.

art.assetsDir: art/ (staged source-of-truth per docs/ART.md; subdirs art/units/{infantry,mech,recon,tank,artillery,commander}.png and art/terrain/{plains,road,forest,mountain,city,hq,sea}.png, each with a manifest.md)
art.recolor: author neutral gray / desaturated; runtime team-color mask/HSV retint (per docs/ART.md + CLAUDE.md)
art.note: Batch-1 sprites are already generated and staged under art/ — do NOT regenerate/clobber them without cause. They are NOT yet wired into the renderer (GameScreen.kt still draws primitives + glyphs, no image loading), so art/ + sprite-wiring is the open task. CLAUDE.md/VISION reference the PixelLab MCP, but pixellab is NOT configured for this repo yet (only Rogueshapes has the server block) — add the same mcpServers block here, or promote pixellab to user scope, before generating more.
